title: Donkey Burgers and the Meaning of Home
description: Steven explains why he runs so many channels, then shares everyday expat life in Beijing: a pricey donkey burger, his go-to foods, new drone restrictions, creatine and gym progress. He closes with a line from American Gods that left him wondering what home really is.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目，史蒂文先聊了聊：他为什么同时经营这么多个频道？
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven first talks about why he runs so many channels at the same time.

sentences.zh: 接着，因为有些听众已经被 AI 话题“刷屏”到腻了，他换了个口味，讲讲在北京做外国人的日常。
sentences.en: Next, because some listeners have grown tired of AI topics flooding their feeds, he changes things up and talks about daily life as a foreigner in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 内容包括一个价格不便宜的驴肉火烧汉堡、他常吃的几样美食，以及无人机新规带来的麻烦。
sentences.en: Topics include a not-so-cheap donkey meat burger, a few of the foods he often eats, and the trouble caused by new drone regulations.

sentences.zh: 他还说起自己对肌酸的误会，和一次让他挺满意的卧推成绩。
sentences.en: He also talks about his misconception about creatine and a bench press result he was quite happy with.

sentences.zh: 最后聊到小说《美国众神》，书里有一句话让他想了很久：家，到底是什么？
sentences.en: Finally, he turns to the novel American Gods, which has a line that made him think for a long time: what exactly is home?

sentences.zh: 为什么开这么多频道？
sentences.en: Why run so many channels?

sentences.zh: 有人问得很直接：史蒂文，你为什么不专心做一个频道？
sentences.en: Someone put it to him bluntly: Steven, why don't you focus on just one channel?

sentences.zh: 他的回答很老实：他不相信任何单一的渠道能养活自己，就像他不愿意只靠一份工资过日子。
sentences.en: His answer was honest: he doesn't believe any single channel can support him, just as he wouldn't want to live on only one paycheck.

sentences.zh: 他承认，这样看上去确实有点三心二意。
sentences.en: He admits that this does look a bit unfocused.

sentences.zh: 如果只能留一个，他会选这档播客，因为拍 vlog 太费精力了。
sentences.en: If he could keep only one, he would choose this podcast, because making vlogs takes too much energy.

sentences.zh: 播客是他用爱发电的事业，还能帮他理清想法。
sentences.en: The podcast is a labor of love for him, and it also helps him sort out his thoughts.

sentences.zh: “史诗病”和 AI 实验
sentences.en: "Epic-itis" and AI experiments

sentences.zh: 他开通 Substack，本想重拾写博客的乐趣，结果却染上了他所谓的“史诗病”（epic-itis）：越看越觉得自己做的东西有毛病，于是迟迟不发，因为他想要的不只是“更好”，而是“史诗级”。
sentences.en: He started a Substack hoping to rediscover the joy of blogging, but instead came down with what he calls "epic-itis": the more he looked at his work, the more flaws he saw, so he kept putting off publishing, because he wanted it to be not just "better" but "epic."

sentences.zh: 他说：“你必须先发布，才能越过这一关。”
sentences.en: He said, "You have to publish first to get past this hurdle."

sentences.zh: 现在他在摆弄 AI 智能体和自动化流程，大家只看得到最后的成品，看不到中间的挣扎。
sentences.en: Now he's tinkering with AI agents and automated workflows; everyone sees only the finished product, not the struggle in between.

sentences.zh: TikTok 直播与这档节目的由来
sentences.en: TikTok livestreaming and the origins of this show

sentences.zh: 他最近也开始在 TikTok 上直播。
sentences.en: He has recently started livestreaming on TikTok too.

sentences.zh: 昨天一个赞都没有，后来忽然涨到了 631 个。
sentences.en: Yesterday he didn't have a single like, then it suddenly jumped to 631.

sentences.zh: 他在 YouTube 上直播失败过，因为从中国连过去不够稳定，TikTok 就顺畅多了。
sentences.en: His attempts to livestream on YouTube have failed because the connection from China wasn't stable enough, whereas TikTok runs much more smoothly.

sentences.zh: 这档节目始于 2021 年，当时他是为了在疫情期间保持心态平和，也想让大家看看外国人在中国的普通生活。
sentences.en: This show began in 2021, when he started it to keep a calm state of mind during the pandemic and also to show people the ordinary life of a foreigner in China.

sentences.zh: 驴肉汉堡与“无聊”的生活
sentences.en: Donkey Meat Burgers and a "Boring" Life

sentences.zh: 周六从健身房走回家，他在大望路附近、税务局旁边的一家店吃了个驴肉汉堡。
sentences.en: Walking home from the gym on Saturday, he ate a donkey meat burger at a shop near Dawanglu, next to the tax bureau.

sentences.zh: 肉夹在长条形的饼里，还有猪油、洋葱和辣椒。
sentences.en: The meat is tucked into a long, narrow flatbread, along with lard, onions and chili peppers.

sentences.zh: 味道不错，但他本以为是 12 到 15 块，结果收了 20。
sentences.en: It tasted good, but he had assumed it would be 12 to 15 yuan, and in the end he was charged 20.

sentences.zh: 也许是“税务局溢价”，也许只是通货膨胀。
sentences.en: Maybe it was a "tax bureau premium," or maybe it was just inflation.

sentences.zh: 一位刚搬到福建的加拿大朋友总劝他多出门逛逛。
sentences.en: A Canadian friend who just moved to Fujian keeps urging him to get out and wander around more.

sentences.zh: 可在中国待了 12 年，他宁愿在家搭建自动化流程，也不想在餐厅里点菜点得磕磕绊绊，走在街上还被人盯着看、被人偷拍。
sentences.en: But after 12 years in China, he would rather stay home building automated workflows than stumble through ordering food in a restaurant and, out on the street, get stared at and secretly photographed.

sentences.zh: 这种事早在他留胡子之前就有了。
sentences.en: This sort of thing was already happening long before he grew a beard.

sentences.zh: 他常吃的几样
sentences.en: A few things he often eats

sentences.zh: 他的“固定菜单”其实很短：
sentences.en: His "set menu" is actually quite short:

sentences.zh: 中式早餐：包子、油条、豆浆
sentences.en: Chinese breakfast: steamed buns, fried dough sticks and soy milk

sentences.zh: 锅包肉：东北的酸甜里脊
sentences.en: Guobaorou: sweet and sour pork tenderloin from Northeast China

sentences.zh: 清真烤串：简直是“穿在签子上的正宗牛排”，再配上馕
sentences.en: Halal kebabs: practically "authentic steak on a skewer," served with naan

sentences.zh: Blue Frog 的双层汉堡：在他看来是世界上最好的汉堡
sentences.en: Blue Frog's double burger: in his view, the best burger in the world

sentences.zh: Blue Frog 周一买一送，两个汉堡加两杯饮料约 160 元，他能分好几顿吃完。
sentences.en: Blue Frog does buy-one-get-one on Mondays: two burgers plus two drinks come to about 160 yuan, and he can split that across several meals.

sentences.zh: 在加拿大花 30 加元吃同样的东西，可真是肉疼。
sentences.en: Spending 30 Canadian dollars on the same thing in Canada really hurts.

sentences.zh: 女朋友的妈妈也常给他送吃的，明星是甜饼（tianbing）：像肉夹馍的那种饼，只不过是封口的，里面包着糖。
sentences.en: His girlfriend's mother also often brings him food, and the star is tianbing: a flatbread like the kind used for roujiamo, except that it's sealed and has sugar inside.

sentences.zh: 加热后配上冰激凌，是绝佳的甜点。
sentences.en: Heated up and served with ice cream, it makes a superb dessert.

sentences.zh: 秋叶与无人机禁令
sentences.en: Autumn leaves and the drone ban

sentences.zh: 树叶终于变色了，秋天正是去长城的好时候。
sentences.en: The leaves have finally changed color, and autumn is the perfect time to visit the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 以前这个季节最适合航拍，可现在在北京，连持有或携带无人机零件都不行，包括过境转机，范围是以北京为中心 300 公里。
sentences.en: This season used to be the best for aerial photography, but now in Beijing even possessing or carrying drone parts isn't allowed, including when transiting, and the restricted area extends 300 kilometers around Beijing.

sentences.zh: 如果从加拿大飞，经北京转机去蒙古，能带无人机吗？
sentences.en: If you fly from Canada and transfer through Beijing on the way to Mongolia, can you bring a drone?

sentences.zh: 机场算北京吗？
sentences.en: Does the airport count as Beijing?

sentences.zh: 他没查到任何信息，而他手里还有一架无人机，所以有点发愁。
sentences.en: He couldn't find any information, and since he still has a drone, he's a bit worried.

sentences.zh: 健身卡、肌酸和新成绩
sentences.en: Gym cards, creatine and new personal bests

sentences.zh: 他的健身房有两种方式：往卡里充钱，或者买按次数计的月卡。
sentences.en: His gym offers two options: load money onto a card, or buy a monthly card that counts visits.

sentences.zh: 月卡的坑在于：中途上个厕所，或者回去取水瓶，就又算一次进场。
sentences.en: The catch with the monthly card is that if you go to the toilet partway through, or go back to get your water bottle, it counts as another entry.

sentences.zh: 他还澄清了一个误会：他喝的是一水肌酸，每天 3 克，并不是蛋白质来源。
sentences.en: He also cleared up a misunderstanding: what he takes is creatine monohydrate, 3 grams a day, and it isn't a source of protein.

sentences.zh: 他以前的肠胃问题多半是乳清蛋白惹的祸，所以现在改喝豌豆蛋白。
sentences.en: His past stomach problems were most likely caused by whey protein, so now he has switched to pea protein.

sentences.zh: 成绩如下：
sentences.en: His results are as follows:

sentences.zh: 卧推：80 公斤，先推 4 个再推 3 个，几乎等于他的体重，也是约 10 年来第一次接近这个数
sentences.en: Bench press: 80 kg, first 4 reps and then 3, almost equal to his body weight, and the first time in about 10 years he has come close to that number

sentences.zh: 硬拉：130 公斤，一次，用了腰带
sentences.en: Deadlift: 130 kg, one rep, using a belt

sentences.zh: 深蹲：停在 80 公斤左右，正在练灵活度和动作标准
sentences.en: Squat: holding at around 80 kg while he works on mobility and form

sentences.zh: “对一个老头来说，不算差。”
sentences.en: "Not bad for an old man."

sentences.zh: 不过，他可算不上多老。
sentences.en: Though he's hardly all that old.

sentences.zh: 以书代酒
sentences.en: Books instead of booze

sentences.zh: 他把泡吧换成了读书。
sentences.en: He replaced going to bars with reading.

sentences.zh: 喝一两杯啤酒，往往以刷 Joe Rogan 的片段、UFC 比赛和《恶搞之家》收场，而书只会在家里占地方。
sentences.en: Having a beer or two usually ends with scrolling through Joe Rogan clips, UFC fights and Family Guy, while the books just take up space at home.

sentences.zh: “如果你宁愿喝啤酒也不愿读书，那不如把书扔了。”
sentences.en: "If you'd rather drink beer than read books, you might as well throw the books away."

sentences.zh: 他终于读完了《美国众神》。
sentences.en: He finally finished reading American Gods.

sentences.zh: 下一本是 Rob Sheffield 的《Love Is a Mixtape》，本是买给女朋友的，还以为是爱情故事，结果是个“死亡故事”，哎呀。
sentences.en: Next up is Rob Sheffield's Love Is a Mixtape, which he originally bought for his girlfriend, thinking it was a love story, but it turned out to be a "death story". Oops.

sentences.zh: 《美国众神》快结尾处有一句话让他停了下来：“他不知道，家是一个地方住久了自然而然发生的事，还是只要你不停地走、不停地等、不停地用意志去追寻，终有一天会找到的东西。”
sentences.en: Near the end of American Gods, one line stopped him: "He did not know whether home is something that happens naturally when you live in a place long enough, or something you will find one day if you just keep walking, keep waiting, and keep pursuing it with your will."

sentences.zh: 这正是“外国人之乡”的写照。
sentences.en: That is exactly what being in a "land of foreigners" is like.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 同时撒下很多网，也许不是最专注的办法，却是他摸索什么行得通的方式。
sentences.en: Casting many nets at once may not be the most focused approach, but it's his way of figuring out what works.

sentences.zh: 有时候，最“无聊”的外国人生活里，也有好吃的汉堡，和书里一句让人记很久的话。
sentences.en: Sometimes even the most "boring" expat life has a tasty burger and a line from a book that stays with you for a long time.

sentences.zh: 家，也许就是你一直住下去，一个地方慢慢变成的样子。
sentences.en: Home may simply be what a place slowly becomes as you keep on living there.

vocab.en: to work out of passion, unpaid
to feel the pinch of spending money
